purpose: Unified engineering and property development parameters for NSW councils, extracted from the council's own DCP, engineering guidelines, specifications and standard drawings saved in the NSW-Councils library. Feeds JCESITE and the development lead pipeline.
record_rules: One record per value. A parameter that varies by road class, zone, lot size, land use or AEP gets one record per case, with the case in 'condition'.
Every record must cite the saved file it came from (path relative to the council folder), the PDF page number, and the clause or table where printed.
quote: the shortest verbatim extract (25 words or fewer) that shows the value. No quote, no record.
value: number where the source gives a number (value_num plus unit); otherwise value_text. Ranges as value_min and value_max.

basis: 'stated' when printed in a council document; 'adopted standard' when the council document says to apply an external standard (e.g. AUS-SPEC D5, WSA 02, Austroads) without giving the number; never fill numbers from external standards yourself.
If the council's documents do not give a parameter, do not create a record. Gaps are listed separately.
Where two council documents conflict, record both and set conflict=true.
Dates DD/MM/YYYY. Units SI as printed (m, mm, %, L/s, L/s/ha, m3/ha, AEP %, EP, ET).

record_fields.category: one of the category keys below
record_fields.parameter: a parameter key from the dictionary below (use 'other:<short_snake_name>' only if nothing fits)
record_fields.condition: the case the value applies to, e.g. 'local access street, under 100 lots', 'R2 zone', 'residential, minor system', or 'all'
record_fields.value_text: text value or null (e.g. 'barrier kerb SA', 'required where impervious area increases')
record_fields.source_file: path relative to council folder, e.g. Engineering/D5 Stormwater Drainage Design.pdf
record_fields.clause: clause, section or table reference as printed
record_fields.document_edition: edition, version or date of the source document if printed, else UNVERIFIED

council_meta_fields.governing_dcp: name, edition, adoption date or UNVERIFIED
council_meta_fields.engineering_basis: council manual name and edition; whether based on AUS-SPEC, Northern Rivers (NRLG), IPWEA, own; edition or UNVERIFIED
council_meta_fields.standard_drawings: set name and edition or UNVERIFIED
council_meta_fields.water_sewer_authority: council or named authority (e.g. Hunter Water, Sydney Water, MidCoast Water)
council_meta_fields.gaps: list of dictionary parameters not found in the council's documents (category level is fine)

dev_controls.min_lot_size: minimum lot size (note if set by LEP lot size map rather than DCP)
dev_controls.battle_axe_min_area: minimum battle-axe lot area (excluding handle if stated)
dev_controls.building_envelope: minimum building envelope / rectangle per lot
dev_controls.private_open_space_min: minimum private open space (area and dimension)
dev_controls.height_max: maximum building height (DCP or LEP reference)
dev_controls.parking_rate: car parking rate by land use
dev_controls.flood_planning_level_freeboard: freeboard above flood level for floor levels
dev_controls.flood_planning_aep: flood event used for flood planning level
dev_controls.garage_setback_behind_facade: garage set back behind building line
dev_controls.dual_occupancy_min_lot: minimum lot size for dual occupancy
dev_controls.site_area_per_dwelling: minimum (or maximum) site area per dwelling for dual occupancy, multi dwelling housing and residential flat buildings
dev_controls.outbuilding_max_area: maximum floor area of detached outbuildings, by lot size
dev_controls.public_open_space_provision: public open space rate, minimum park area or walking distance

setbacks.side_setback: side setback (by wall height or storey)
setbacks.garage_setback: garage or carport setback to street
setbacks.setback_rural: setbacks in rural or large lot zones
setbacks.setback_classified_road: setback to classified or arterial roads

roads.road_hierarchy: road class definition (lots served or ADT threshold); value_text = class name
roads.carriageway_width: carriageway width (kerb invert to kerb invert unless stated) by class
roads.verge_width: verge or footway width by class
roads.vertical_curve_min_length: minimum vertical curve length or K value
roads.kerb_return_radius: kerb return radius by intersecting road classes
roads.property_boundary_splay: corner splay or truncation at intersections
roads.cul_de_sac_max_length: maximum cul-de-sac length or lots served
roads.turning_head_type: permitted turning head types (bulb, T, hammerhead)
roads.design_vehicle: design or check vehicle by class (e.g. 8.8 m MRV, 12.5 m HRV, garbage truck)
roads.kerb_type: kerb and gutter profile by road class (e.g. barrier SA, roll top)
roads.pavement_design_traffic: design traffic (ESA or DESA) by road class
roads.wearing_surface: wearing course or seal type by class
roads.subgrade_testing: subgrade CBR testing frequency or requirement
roads.footpath_requirement: where footpaths are required and on which side
roads.street_lighting_standard: street lighting category or AS/NZS 1158 reference
roads.rural_road_seal_width: rural road seal width by class
roads.rural_road_formation_width: rural road formation width by class
roads.half_road_construction: half road or frontage works requirements
roads.road_standard_basis: external standard adopted for road design (Austroads part, AUS-SPEC D1 etc)
roads.traffic_lane_width: width of one through traffic lane (distinct from carriageway width)
roads.long_grade_max_length: maximum length over which the maximum longitudinal grade may be used
roads.intersection_min_angle: minimum intersection angle between road centrelines
roads.road_class_max_traffic: traffic volume (vpd) or dwelling threshold defining each road class
roads.path_grade_max: maximum longitudinal grade of footpaths and shared paths
roads.path_crossfall_max: maximum crossfall of footpaths and shared paths
roads.pavement_material_cbr_min: minimum soaked CBR of pavement layer materials (base, subbase)

access.driveway_distance_from_intersection: minimum distance from intersection or tangent point
access.rural_access_width: rural access width or sealed apron length
access.battle_axe_driveway_width: driveway pavement width in access handles
access.shared_driveway_width: shared or community title driveway width
access.passing_bay_requirement: passing bay requirement on long driveways
access.driveway_setback_boundary: minimum offset of a driveway from a side boundary
access.rural_access_culvert_min_length: minimum length of a rural access pipe culvert

stormwater.minor_system_aep: minor system design event by land use or road class
stormwater.pipe_min_diameter: minimum pipe diameter (road drainage, interallotment, private)
stormwater.pipe_min_cover_other: minimum cover in verges, lots, reserves
stormwater.pit_location: pit location requirements (in gutter, tangent points, sags)
stormwater.inlet_blockage_factor: blockage factors for inlets (on grade, sag)
stormwater.pipe_blockage_factor: blockage factors for pipes or culverts
stormwater.hgl_freeboard: HGL freeboard below pit lids or inlets
stormwater.road_flow_width_max: maximum gutter flow width or travel lane encroachment
stormwater.flow_depth_velocity_product: maximum depth times velocity (d.v) for safety
stormwater.overland_flow_path_requirement: overland flow path width, freeboard to floor levels
stormwater.floor_level_freeboard_overland: freeboard from floor levels to major flow
stormwater.kerb_outlet_requirement: kerb outlet or street drainage connection rules for lots
stormwater.rainwater_tank_requirement: rainwater tank size or BASIX link
stormwater.stormwater_standard_basis: external standard adopted (AUS-SPEC D5, QUDM, ARR) without numbers
stormwater.inlet_capacity_allowed: allowable percentage of theoretical pit inlet capacity (complement of the blockage factor); record where the source tabulates capacity allowed rather than blockage
stormwater.fraction_impervious: fraction or percentage impervious by land use or lot size, including the runoff contribution assumed for interallotment drainage
stormwater.runoff_coefficient: Rational Method runoff coefficient (C10 or similar) by land use and slope
stormwater.hydrologic_loss_parameters: initial and continuing loss, ILSAX depression storage and soil type parameters
stormwater.climate_change_rainfall_factor: rainfall intensity increase or multiplier adopted for climate change
stormwater.osd_ponding_depth_max: maximum ponding depth for OSD storage on driveways, car parks and landscaped areas
stormwater.wsud_hydrocarbon_reduction: total hydrocarbons or oil and grease reduction target
stormwater.gpt_design_event: design flow event for gross pollutant traps
stormwater.bulkhead_grade_threshold: pipe grade above which trench stops or concrete bulkheads are required

earthworks.cut_fill_max_dcp: maximum cut or fill under DCP controls
earthworks.retaining_wall_max_height_exempt: retaining wall height without approval or engineer
earthworks.fill_compaction_standard: compaction standard (e.g. 98 percent standard, AS 3798 level 1)
earthworks.lot_grading_min: minimum lot grade towards street or drainage
earthworks.lot_fill_flood: lot filling relative to flood levels
earthworks.erosion_control_basis: erosion and sediment control reference (Blue Book) and thresholds

water.dead_end_main_max_length: maximum length (and dwellings served) of dead end water mains
water.water_main_velocity_max: maximum flow velocity in water mains
water.water_headloss_max: maximum headloss rate in water mains

sewer.sewer_design_code: design code (WSA 02 edition, local supplement, WSA 07 pressure)
sewer.sewer_ep_per_lot: equivalent population or ET per lot or dwelling
sewer.onsite_wastewater: on-site sewage management requirements and minimum lot size
sewer.manhole_max_depth: maximum maintenance hole or maintenance shaft depth
sewer.manhole_internal_drop: internal drop across maintenance holes by deflection angle
sewer.rising_main_velocity: minimum and maximum rising main velocity
sewer.pump_station_requirements: pump station design limits (pump head, run time, emergency storage and response time, pressure rating)

contributions.s712_plan: section 7.12 plan name and levy rate
contributions.contribution_rate_per_lot: contribution rate per lot or dwelling
contributions.dsp_water: water development servicing plan or charge
contributions.dsp_sewer: sewer development servicing plan or charge

documentation.cctv_requirement: CCTV of stormwater or sewer before handover
documentation.subdivision_works_certificate: SWC process or council certifier requirement
documentation.design_certification: who must certify designs (CPEng, NER, RPEQ)
